title: 第26章 邵扒皮第27章 儒道浩然之力
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
“刑使张远拜见点司大人。”刑台之前，张远躬身。
领着他来的黑袍狱卒站到后方。
刑台上，一位身形单薄的囚犯被几道锁链锁住手脚，跪在那。
点刑司点刑官涂皓目光扫过，淡淡道：“奉刀。”
张远已经熟悉流程，毫不犹豫飞身踏上刑台，去木架上提一柄鬼头刀，捧在怀中。
随着修为的提升，刑台的煞气和死寂之气对他已经没有影响。
便是上首修儒道的点刑官涂皓目光他也敢直面。
谨守心神，真元压住神魂，不为外物所侵。
这是金城陆和赵平川所说，应对儒道和仙道迷惑心神手段时候的策略。
只要心神坚定，就不为外邪所趁。
双手捧刀，张远目光落在今日要被行刑的案犯身上。
蓬乱头发，身上衣衫倒还整齐，面色苍白，胡须黏在脸上。
不像是武道高手，倒有几分老儒生的感觉。
张远认得，这个人是白马山上专门管着财货之人，一把算盘极为精细，乃是白马山大当家最信重的人。
“案犯邵明经，白马山匪徒，参与白马山劫掠，一应财货皆经手，你可承认。”
上首，点司涂皓的声音响起。
张远这一次能清晰感觉到一丝要穿透皮肤的神魂力量冲向刑台，压在那邵明经的身上。
邵明经浑身一颤，双目呆滞。
“承认。”
“案犯邵明经，参与白马山劫掠商队案件十三起，劫掠村庄五座，经手财货折合白银七千两，你可承认？”

“承认。”
“案犯邵明经知法犯法，助纣为虐，庐阳府镇抚司验明正身，处以极刑，你可还有话说？”涂皓的声音之中透出一丝清淡，少了几分冷厉。
原本低着头的邵明经茫然抬头，他张张嘴，似乎想说什么。
“邵明经，你也曾读书明理，白马山匪徒所获财货在何处，如何打理，你若是说出，本点司愿意为你说话，你的罪责或许不至于斩首。”涂皓的声音再低沉几分，轻缓许多。
张远立在那，感觉到身周的神魂力量不但没有减少，反而已经压迫到极致。
“我……”邵明经的声音嘶哑，双目之中没有神采。
“我不知道。”
这话语一出，上首端坐的涂皓浑身一颤，面色瞬间胀红，然后又透出惨白。
张远感觉身周压迫的神魂力量瞬间散去。
点司涂皓的儒道神魂之法被破了。
张远看向邵明经，见他手掌紧握，一丝鲜血从中流淌。
关键时候借助伤残身躯，引动神魂震动，破去儒道神魂压制。
邵明经也是修过儒道，知道如何去应对儒道。
content_en:
"The executioner Zhang Yuan pays homage to Master Dian Si." Zhang Yuan bowed before the execution platform.
The black-robed jailer who led him stood behind him.
On the execution platform, a thin prisoner was kneeling there with his hands and feet bound by several chains.
Tu Hao, the execution officer of the Punishment Department, glanced over and said calmly: "Feng Dao."
Zhang Yuan was already familiar with the process, and without hesitation, he flew onto the execution platform, picked up a ghost-head knife from the wooden frame, and held it in his arms.
As his cultivation level improved, the evil aura and deathly aura of the torture platform no longer affected him.
He dared to look directly into the eyes of Tu Hao, the chief punishment officer who practiced Confucianism.
Guard your mind carefully, your true energy suppresses your soul, and is not invaded by external objects.
This is what Jincheng Lu and Zhao Pingchuan said was a strategy for dealing with Confucianism and Immortalism’s methods of confusing the mind.
As long as your mind is firm, you will not be taken advantage of by external evil.
Holding a knife in both hands, Zhang Yuan's eyes fell on the criminal who was going to be executed today.
His hair was disheveled, his clothes were neat, his face was pale, and his beard was stuck to his face.
He doesn't look like a martial arts master, but feels a bit like an old Confucian scholar.
Zhang Yuan recognized that this person was a person who specialized in managing property on Baima Mountain. His abacus was extremely precise, and he was the most trusted person by the head of Baima Mountain.
"The criminal, Shao Mingjing, is a bandit from Baima Mountain. He participated in the robbery of Baima Mountain and handled all the goods. You can admit it."
From the top, Si Tuhao's voice sounded.
This time Zhang Yuan could clearly feel the power of the soul that was about to penetrate the skin and rush towards the execution platform, pressing on Shao Mingjing's body.
Shao Mingjing trembled all over and his eyes were dull.
"Admit it."
"The criminal, Shao Mingjing, participated in thirteen caravan robbery cases in Baima Mountain, robbed five villages, and handled goods equivalent to seven thousand taels of silver. Can you admit it?"
"Admit it."
"The criminal Shao Ming knew the law and broke the law, and helped Zhou to commit evil. The Luyang Prefecture's Fu Si verified his identity and sentenced him to death. Do you have anything to say?" There was a hint of calmness in Tu Hao's voice, less cold and harsh.
Shao Mingjing, who had his head lowered, looked up blankly and opened his mouth as if he wanted to say something.
"Shao Mingjing, you have also read and understood clearly. Where is the property obtained by the Baima Mountain bandits and how to take care of it. If you tell me, and the Bendian Division is willing to speak for you, your guilt may not lead to beheading." Tu Hao's voice was a little lower and gentler.
Zhang Yuan stood there and felt that the power of the soul around him not only did not decrease, but was oppressed to the extreme.
"I..." Shao Mingjing's voice was hoarse, and his eyes were lifeless.
"I don't know."
As soon as these words came out, Tu Hao, who was sitting upright, trembled all over, his face instantly turned red, and then turned pale again.
Zhang Yuan felt that the oppressive soul power around him dissipated instantly.
Tu Hao's Confucianism and Taoism method was broken.
Zhang Yuan looked at Shao Mingjing and saw that his palms were clenched with a trace of blood flowing from them.
At the critical moment, he used his disabled body to cause the soul to vibrate and break the suppression of Confucianism and Taoism.
Shao Mingjing also practiced Confucianism and Taoism and knew how to deal with Confucianism and Taoism.
